control.recovery_definition: first recorded sweep with order_parameter >= threshold for the configured number of consecutive measurements
control.reference_state: state entering each epsilon on one unperturbed high-to-low continuation scan; clean path then evolves for one interval
control.perturbation: independent threshold-level shock; matched standardized Gaussian direction across sigma conditions; clipped to [0,1]
control.paired_on: network seed, baseline reference path, epsilon-specific shock direction, and epsilon-specific dynamics RNG stream
